output.population: Human patients with medically refractory epilepsy requiring surgically implanted intracranial electrodes; ages 13–59
output.summary: Electrical stimulation through implanted intracranial electrodes recorded concurrently with whole-brain functional MRI in patients with medically refractory epilepsy. Pre- and post-implantation sessions include structural scans, resting-state scans, electrode coordinates, stimulation parameters and preprocessed derivatives.
